lcc_original: 塞特在世的日子、共有九百一十二年，然後死。
notes: UNV {<WAH01961>}{<WTH8799>} were implicit (no Chinese character); LCC's 有 explicitly realizes H1961 (הָיָה = to be/were), so braces dropped and both tags attached to 有 per Rule 3.
UNV {<WH03117>} (יְמֵי = days) was implicit; LCC's 日子 is explicit, so braces dropped and tag attached to 日子 per Rule 3.

Hebrew שָׁנָה (H8141) appears twice: once after מֵאוֹת (nine hundred[s of] years) and once after the full numeral. UNV reflects this with a floating <WH08141> between 百 and 一十二, plus 歲<WH08141>. LCC collapses both into a single 年 — both H8141 tags attached to 年 per Rule 6.
LCC's 在世的 ('in the world', a periphrastic expansion) and 然後 ('then/afterwards', a Chinese discourse connector) have no direct Hebrew equivalents and are left unannotated per Rule 5.
